summary: This bill makes it unlawful to knowingly distribute private intimate visual depictions of adults without their consent, or visual depictions of nude minors with intent to abuse or gratify sexual desire, and establishes penalties including fines, imprisonment, and forfeiture.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates new federal offenses related to the nonconsensual distribution of intimate visual depictions and visual depictions of nude minors, establishing penalties including imprisonment and forfeiture. This directly strengthens criminal justice measures against such acts.
